recipes.name: Vegan Garlic Naan
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the butter (or oil), garlic, and salt. Whisk and set aside.
In a large bowl, mix the flour, yogurt, milk, sugar, baking powder, and the remaining salt until just combined.
Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead until smooth. If it sticks to your hands or the surface, sprinkle with more flour as needed.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions. Roll each piece into an oval shape, about 1/16 inch / 2 mm thick, adding flour as needed to prevent sticking.
Preheat a large skillet (such as a cast-iron skillet) over medium-high heat. Sprinkle some of the cilantro on one side of a naan and lightly roll over it with a rolling pin to help it stick.
Flip the naan so the cilantro side is facing down, then lightly brush the top with water.
Place the naan, water-side down, into the hot pan and cook until bubbles form and the bottom is golden, about 1 minute.
Flip the naan, quickly add 1 teaspoon water around the edge of the pan, cover, and steam until the bottom is golden, about 1 minute.

Uncover and reduce the heat to medium. Brush the top with the garlic butter. Flip and cook for 30 seconds, or until the garlic is fragrant and golden. Brush the top with more garlic butter, then flip and cook for another 30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm.
Repeat with the remaining naan and garlic butter, wiping the skillet clean after each batch.
Serve warm (alongside your favorite curry). Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use a plant-based yogurt and milk that are fortified with calcium .

Storage Best to enjoy freshly made. Store leftovers in an airtight container on the counter for up to 1 day. Freeze, separated by layers of parchment paper, in a well-sealed container for up to 1 month. Simply thaw and re-toast when ready to enjoy.
